Alpha Strike

Can be cast only on a friendly creature. Enchanted creature gains Trample and First Strike abilities, and it's power increased by X, where X is the creature's initial power. Toughness of the enchanted creature becomes equal to 1. At the end of turn destroy enchanted creature, it can't use regeneration ability to counter this effect
